messages:
sara: kicking off perf run for OrionEdge POC. They want sustained low-latency for chat + occasional high-burst batch. Can we confirm test plan and who owns pricing/security asks?

devon: I can own the run. quick q: model & prompt mix? seq len distribution?

liam: suggested mix: 70% chat gen (avg 256 tokens), 25% short completions (64 tokens), 5% embeddings/other. target sustained 600 qps, burst to 2k for ~30s. tail-latency SLO 99th < 400ms for chat.

anita: customer flagged FIPS/KMS + HSM requirement in their security questionnaire. also need audit logs for tokens. timeline: pilot next week, private deploy decision depends on KMS answer.

devon: ok. I'll run two phases: hosted baseline (to show delta) then dedicated pool sim. can we get a sample prompt set from them for quality/regression check?

liam: build plan:
```yaml
run_id: orionedge-poc-2026-03
phases:
  - name: hosted-smoke
    qps: 50
    duration: 10m
  - name: sustained
    qps: 600
    duration: 2h
  - name: burst-waves
    qps: 2000
    duration: 30s
    repeat: 12
metrics: [p50,p95,p99,errors,cold_start_rate,cpu_gpu_util]
models: [open-llama-70b-qat, redwood-lite-13b-q4]
notes: enable prefix-caching for chat to show cache benefit
```

devon: load command (local harness):
```bash
./runner --target https://api.redwood.ai/generate \
  --concurrency 400 --qps 600 --duration 7200 \
  --payload-file orion_prompts.json --auth-token $POC_TOKEN
```

deploy-bot: loadjob orionedge-poc-2026-03 started (run id 98321)

liam: early note: hosted baseline will show higher tail because of multi-tenant cold starts. dedicated pool should drop p99 by ~120-200ms. we'll capture KV cache hit rates to prove it.

anita: security triage: customer wants KMS keys in their tenancy and HSM-backed wrapping. For hosted we can offer CMEK with partner KMS but not HSM by default. Private deploy can integrate HSM but needs 2-4 week lead time + legal.

sara: pricing ask from them: price for sustained 600 qps with bursts, and committed dedicated monthly. can you draft a ballpark so I can push during call?

devon: ballpark: hosted metered - est ~$0.09 per 1k chat tokens at this model mix => rough monthly burn depends on tokens. For sustained Dedicated: reserved capacity (2x N gpus) estimate ~$45k/mo for reserved fleet that meets 600qps with headroom + burst policy on top. Need finance to firm up.

liam: add: optimize quantization to q4_0 for dedicated; reduces GPU requirements by ~30% in our tests. note this impacts perf at edge of quality. include quality regression check.

anita: we'll prepare a 1-pager for the security questionnaire:
- KMS: support CMEK for hosted; customer-managed keys for dedicated/private
- HSM: available only for Private (on-prem or VPC appliance), timeline 2-4 weeks
- Audit logs: available; retention options (30/90/365 days)
- SOC / ISO artifacts: send link to security pack

sara: can we get draft answers by EOD? They're in demo on Friday.

devon: yes. I'll run the hosted baseline tonight and share p50/p95/p99 + sample traces. liam will run dedicated sim tomorrow once finance okays cadence.

liam: running quick smoke now to validate harness. pasted a small log from the runner: 
```
[2026-03-21 02:12:04] INFO warmup complete - 50req/s
[2026-03-21 02:20:15] WARN observed cold_start 3.2%
[2026-03-21 02:22:01] METRIC p95=220ms p99=410ms errors=0.6%
```

anita: noted. I'll start drafting the sec answers. sara: I'll flag the HSM timeline in the doc so expectations are clear.

sara: perfect. devon, paste the hosted result link once available and a short TL;DR for sales slides.

devon: copied. TL;DR coming: hosted shows p99 ~410ms with current model and caching off; dedicated expected p99 ~220-260ms with q4 quant and prefix caching. will include cost delta.

sara: thanks team. next sync 10:30 PT tomorrow before demo. :thumbsup:
